newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish electricity generation up 10.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Turkish electricity generation up 10.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Turkey's electric power production rose by 10.5 percent to 95.373 million kiloWatt-hours (kWh) in 1996 from 86.291 million kWh the previous year, the State Institute of Statistics said on Wednesday.
Turkey is believed to have consumed about 97.5 million kWh in 1996, according to energy officials, and began power imports late last year from Iran and Bulgaria to make up for the shortfall.
Officials have said imports would continue until Turkey completed investments in the energy sector, which needs about $3.5 billion each year to meet an annual energy demand rise of about 10 percent.
